name: Create after a missing-file check (TOCTOU)
source: CWE-367: the canonical form, os.Stat reporting not-exist and then os.Create. Known miss: security.toctou_check_then_act gates on the file existing (os.Stat err == nil) and lists Open, OpenFile, Remove, RemoveAll and ReadFile as the acts, so this create-after-missing form is not reported
